Maya R.: hey all, first day! trying to flip a staging feature flag for my onboarding smoke tests but console gives 403. followed quickstart. who grants staging-console access?

Diego Ortiz: welcome Maya :wave: you need console-staging-read and ff-operator for toggles. I can request a 6h JIT. which flag and why?

Maya R.: flag is chaos_injector_enabled in staging, only toggling for a controlled smoke to verify observability. sent smoke plan to Diego.

Samir K.: requesting temporary roles now. infra-bot created request #30456 and routed to Maya's manager.

infra-bot: Provisioning request queued (#30456).

Diego Ortiz: approved by manager, granting ff-operator + staging-read for 6h. you should get an email invite.

Maya R.: accepted invite, can see flags. flipping to true and running tests. Thanks!

Maya R.: tests passed, rolling back to false and closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
